# Breezy

> Breezy is the friendliest AI builder for shipping web apps. Describe it, see it, ship it — files, commands, and a live preview, all in your browser.

Breezy lets you vibe-code beautiful full-stack web apps in minutes. A streaming, tool-calling AI agent writes real files, runs commands in a secure in-browser sandbox, and shows a live preview as it works. Projects and conversations are saved to your account.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What Breezy is and how vibe-coding works.
- [Sign in](/auth): Sign in or create an account to start building.
